basic_info.description: Exemplifying modern architecture and design is Rowan 808, situated high with views of Potrero, the Bridge and the bay. Rowan stands tall in the Mission/Potrero skyline and was built with the highest standards providing an exemplary experience for residents. A wonderful example of contemporary living, this corner 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home features exposed concrete ceilings and an efficient floorplan. Floor-to-ceiling windows and a juliet balcony off the living room provide natural light throughout the day. Luxury finishes are found throughout the home including Domas and Domas cabinetry, a Bertazzoni range, and central air conditioning and heat. One floor up is a spectacular roof deck with grills, a fire pit, seating areas, a living herb wall, and views of Sutro Tower and the San Francisco hills. In-unit laundry, one car parking and additional storage complete this amazing home. The amenities at Rowan include a front desk attendant, bike storage, a secure package room, zen garden, professional management, and an incredible roof deck with seating, a fire pit, barbecues, and views of Sutro Tower and the city.
